caption: The drawing shows a stylized tree with a green trunk and branches at the center, which extend outward and upward in an arching pattern. The branches display pairs of greenish-gold oval leaves and clusters of round red berries. Three birds are perched among the branches, colored in shades of blue with touches of red and dark accents. Below the tree, a wavy blue and green pattern suggests grass or stylized ground, atop a mound filled with alternating golden yellow and blue wavy shapes. On the left and right sides of the ground, large symmetrical flowers are illustrated, each featuring yellow and orange petals with curved, pale yellow stems that have dotted tendrils extending outward. The background is a light beige color with a slightly wrinkled texture, and the entire scene is framed on the top and bottom by a thick, wavy red border.
title: Valance
